title: kate-core: indent after a brace before a block comment
summary: A cstyle newline still adds one unit when a block comment follows a brace. A brace inside the comment does not add a unit. The test goes in the existing indent tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: indent.rs is a private module of workspace.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only ends_with_opener. Keep the // split. Then let code = code.split_once("/*").map(|(head, _)| head).unwrap_or(code); then the existing matches! on code.trim_end_matches([' ', '\t']). The opener scalars stay { ( and [. Use the array [' ', '\t']. Do not compare a character with a space or a tab by hand. Do not match Option by hand. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch ends_with_colon, python_newline, is_comment_line, is_dedent_word, or indent_unit. You may update the comment on ends_with_opener so it names a block comment as well as //. The existing tests cstyle_newline_adds_one_unit_after_a_brace and a_comment_after_a_brace_still_indents stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_block_comment_after_a_brace_still_indents uses the helper inserted with cstyle true and DocumentConfig::default. Four spaces, foo, {, space, /*, space, note returns a newline and eight spaces. Four spaces, /*, space, { returns a newline and four spaces. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: workspace::indent::tests::a_block_comment_after_a_brace_still_indents
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A brace before a block comment copies the indent only. After the change it adds one unit. A brace inside the block comment does not add a unit.
